articles.title: Ubuntu 26.10 Adds New Security Protection to curl, Blocking Revoked SSL Certificates
articles.summary:
Ubuntu 26.10 Stonking Stingray adds certificate revocation checks to curl, helping the command-line tool reject HTTPS connections that use revoked certificates. Announced on November 10, the change brings upki support into Ubuntu’s curl package. It marks an initial step toward browser-grade certificate checks across the operating system. The protection closes a gap in how applications […]

articles.title: Hackers Could Abuse Microsoft Entra AI Agents to Hijack Enterprise Accounts Without Stealing Passwords
articles.summary:

The technique is called BluePhishing. It targets Microsoft Entra Agent ID, the system that gives AI agents their own identities inside […]

articles.title: AI Hacking Frameworks Like ARTEX, PentAGI, and Agent Zero Found Running on Internet-Accessible Servers
articles.summary:

articles.title: Windows SignDrop 0-Day Exploit Lets Attackers Gain SYSTEM Privileges Through CLFS Protection
articles.summary:

It claims to turn a normal user account into a SYSTEM account, the highest level of control on Windows. The flaw has no CVE number and no patch as of November 11, 2026. Microsoft […]

articles.title: eMudhra Revokes 8 More Certificate Authorities Following Major SSL Private Key Security Failure
articles.summary:
eMudhra has revoked eight additional intermediate certificate authorities (CAs) after conducting a thorough review of the key issue that led to its October security failure. The new group did not have weak keys, but eMudhra could not prove the keys were handled the way its own rules require. The company has now pulled 16 intermediate […]

articles.title: N-able Releases Emergency N-central Hotfix After 33 Vulnerabilities Trigger Worldwide Shutdown
articles.summary:
N-able has released N-central 2026.4 Hotfix 2 after the public disclosure of 33 alleged vulnerabilities forced a worldwide shutdown of its hosted remote monitoring and management platform. Released on November 10, the emergency update, build 2026.4.1.26, fixes seven published CVEs and adds security changes across the server, Agents, and Probes. The shutdown began on November […]

articles.title: Grok AI App Builder Exposes Over 35,000 Apps, Leaking Confidential Business Data and Passwords
articles.summary:

articles.summary:
